name: Las Vegas Fur Con
blurb: A 21-and-up furry convention at the Alexis Park Resort in Las Vegas, run by the nonprofit Southern Nevada Anthropomorphic Events.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'Las Vegas Fur Con March 25—28, 2027' and 'LVFC 2027: Just Like Clockwork will be held March 25—28, 2027.'

notes: The site's 2026 Guests-of-Honor page (/guests-of-honor/) now 404s and a search for 'Las Vegas Fur Con 2027 guest of honor' turned up only confirmation that none has been announced yet, so guests is 'none-yet'. The venue (Alexis Park Resort) is confirmed by that search since the homepage itself only names it in an unrelated photo's alt text ('Attendees congregate around pool 1 at Alexis Park'); the site has no og:image, so the cover uses its small site logo instead of a crowd photo.
